hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Protocol vaults. In beforeSwap, input tokens are deposited into an Euler vault and output tokens are withdrawn from another vault; a custom curve invariant enforces valid reserve ratios. The hook blocks native concentrated liquidity (beforeAddLiquidity reverts) and unauthorized pool initialization (beforeInitialize reverts).
